description: Retrieves official EDGA Tour schedules, stage dates, divisions, season highlights, and real-time division standings from Tjing, strictly restricted to configured EDGA Tour competitions.

division.description: Division code, case-insensitive (e.g. MPO, FPO, MP40, MA4, FA4). Required for all standings requests. Event divisions are independent of season points eligibility.

stage_id.description: Event stage UUID; supported only with standings and division. Must belong to the selected configured Tour year (current year if omitted).

view.description: View type: 'schedule' for tour stages and dates, 'standings' for division points leaderboard, 'divisions' for official points divisions, 'seasons' for an overview of all configured tour years, 'stats' for season leaders.

year.description: Tour competition year. Available years: 2026, 2025. Omit this field to use the current EDGA Tour year.

name: get_edga_tour
